title: Research: Alertmanager's route, receivers and webhook payload, and Prometheus's alerting block, are kb facts
goal: kb/public/logs/prometheus-retention-exposition.md gains DOC facts with source rows from the Prometheus and Alertmanager docs pinned at a release tag on: the alerting.alertmanagers block of prometheus.yml (static_configs targets, path prefix); the Alertmanager configuration file (route with receiver, group_by, group_wait, group_interval and repeat_interval, receivers, webhook_configs with url and send_resolved, plus how a url or credential can come from a file); the JSON body a webhook receiver gets (version, status, receiver, groupLabels, commonLabels, alerts with status, labels, annotations, startsAt, endsAt, fingerprint); the --web.listen-address flag and its default port; that send_resolved decides whether a webhook receiver is notified of resolved alerts (default true)

run:
import subprocess, sys
ART = 'kb/public/logs/prometheus-retention-exposition.md'
CASES = [
    ('How is Prometheus configured to send firing alerts to an Alertmanager?', 'DOC', ['alertmanagers', 'static_configs']),
    ('Which path prefix setting does the Prometheus alertmanagers block take?', 'DOC', ['alertmanagers', 'path_prefix']),
    ('What do the group_wait and group_interval of an Alertmanager route control?', 'DOC', ['group_wait', 'group_interval']),
    ('What does an Alertmanager route repeat_interval control?', 'DOC', ['repeat_interval']),
    ('How does Alertmanager send an alert to a webhook receiver?', 'DOC', ['webhook_configs', 'url']),
    ('Can an Alertmanager webhook url or credential be read from a file?', 'DOC', ['webhook', 'url_file']),
    ('What JSON body does an Alertmanager webhook receiver get?', 'DOC', ['groupLabels', 'fingerprint']),
    ('What is the Alertmanager web.listen-address flag and its default port?', 'DOC', ['web.listen-address', '9093']),
    ('What does the send_resolved setting of an Alertmanager webhook receiver do and what is its default?', 'DOC', ['send_resolved', 'true']),
]
miss = []
for q, tag, terms in CASES:
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', q, '--root', 'public', '--budget', '2500'],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('- ' + ART[len('kb/'):] + ':') and '[' + tag in l
           and all(t.lower() in l.lower() for t in terms)]
    if not hit:
        miss.append((q, terms))
print('missing:', miss if miss else 'none')
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
